name: conversation-minimap
title: Conversation Minimap
description: A conversation map with one tick per user message and the app's marks, its reply's sections (the app's `sections`, or its headings read from the reply while rendered) as ticks under it; the ticks fall off as a dock's icons, the one being read longest (24px) and darkest, each row further a step shorter and lighter, short and faint (8px) from the fifth on, centred on the row under the pointer or with focus while one is, a section or mark a step behind a turn; hovered or focused, a tick's card: the question's first line, the reply's opening (the app's `reply`, or its first paragraph) in two lines, its attachments and its sections, the hovered one bold. Click or Enter jumps there; arrows move between ticks, with previous and next turn buttons. The error kind is a graphite diamond; a mark is a shorter tick. Shows only where the margin beside an AgentAppColumn has room, below a pinned ConversationDetails card, hiding when too little height is left. Hidden on touch screens and phones and when the conversation fits. Use inside MessageScrollerProvider beside the viewport.
